nodes.label: 0.0.0.0 Redirect Issue
nodes.rationale: Binding Next.js dev server to 0.0.0.0 causes NextAuth to read 0.0.0.0 from request headers, so post-login/logout redirects point to the wrong host instead of the IP actually used to access the app.

nodes.label: NEXTAUTH_URL Fix Summary
nodes.rationale: Setting NEXTAUTH_URL explicitly tells NextAuth the correct externally-visible URL, preventing it from falling back to the 0.0.0.0 bind address seen in request headers.

nodes.label: Upload Fix (Quick Start)
nodes.rationale: Images uploaded via CMS did not appear until pm2 restart; fix migrates uploads out of public/uploads and serves them via an API route so pm2/standalone mode picks them up immediately.

nodes.label: Next.js Standalone Mode File Serving Limitation
nodes.norm_label: next.js standalone mode file serving limitation
nodes.rationale: Standalone mode's static file server does not pick up files written to public/ after build/start, so uploads silently fail to appear until a full process restart.

nodes.label: Upload Fix (Instructions)
nodes.rationale: Next.js standalone mode does not serve newly added files from public/uploads without a restart; moving uploads outside public and serving them through a dynamic API route avoids the restart requirement under pm2.

nodes.label: Smart Redirect Callback
nodes.rationale: Detects hostname 0.0.0.0, prefers NEXTAUTH_URL, falls back to the referer header, and substitutes the correct hostname so redirects work automatically across dev/LAN/production without manually swapping env values every time.
